result.markdown:
# Abnormally High Traffic at S-TUN-002 Due to Stadium Concert

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-002`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by external event EVT-004 matching the exact timeframe of the traffic and user spike, with no changes or maintenance found.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 19:00 to 2026-09-28 22:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 18:56
- **Affected:** S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-003

## Summary

Traffic surge driven by a concert at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-004) near the site.

Abnormally high traffic, active users, and PRB utilization across S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, and S-TUN-003 starting at 2026-09-28 19:00 and recovering by 2026-09-28 22:30.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 18:56: Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades started [EVT-004]
- 2026-09-28 19:00: Earliest KPI onset observed with S-TUN-002 active_users above baseline [T7]
- 2026-09-28 19:15: Detector alert ALR-0040 started for S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003 [ALR-0040]
- 2026-09-28 19:58: Warning high PRB alarm raised on S-TUN-001 [ALM-000633]
- 2026-09-28 20:14: Warning high PRB alarm raised on S-TUN-002 [ALM-000634]
- 2026-09-28 22:30: KPIs recovered to baseline levels [T7]
- 2026-09-28 22:37: Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades ended [EVT-004]
- 2026-09-28 22:53: Warning high PRB alarm cleared on S-TUN-002 [ALM-000634]
- 2026-09-28 22:55: Warning high PRB alarm cleared on S-TUN-001 [ALM-000633]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-002 experienced an active users spike, dl volume mb spike, and latency ms spike during the event window. [ANM-000423, ANM-000424, ANM-000435]
- External event EVT-004 (Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades) occurred between 2026-09-28 18:56 and 2026-09-28 22:37. [EVT-004]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-003 or their parents during the incident window. [T4]
- No configuration changes were made on S-TUN-002 and its parents during the incident window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-002: confirmed. Traffic and user spikes precisely align temporally and geographically with the concert event EVT-004. [EVT-004, T7]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-002: rejected. No changes were executed on S-TUN-002 or its parents during the relevant time frame. [T5]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000633: Warning high PRB alarm on S-TUN-001 cleared by itself and was a byproduct of localized congestion from the stadium crowd surge.
- ALM-000634: Warning high PRB alarm on S-TUN-002 cleared by itself and was a byproduct of localized congestion from the stadium crowd surge.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor stadium events routinely for anticipated traffic surges in nearby sectors.
